breakingChanges: New session IDs include protocol, interface, network, contract domains, and a buyer-scoped idempotency key.
Session creation signature requires fixed-size 32-byte idempotency_key.
Usage commitments use a separately domain-separated XDR preimage.
Supported asset storage changes from a boolean marker to an explicit lifecycle state.
Session duration is strictly capped at max_session_duration_ledgers (518,400 ledgers).
compatibilityNotes: Route every existing v2 session to its original v2 contract ID.
Do not recompute or reinterpret v2 identifiers using the v3 domain rules.
Create all new domain-separated sessions on a v3 replacement deployment initialized with the reviewed active asset set.
Do not copy a deprecated asset into v3 unless an administrator explicitly reactivates it during deployment review.
Session retries with identical parameters return the existing session id without advancing sequence or moving funds.
Session creation halts deterministically with SequenceExhausted when terminal sequence capacity is reached.
Admin can safely recover unbacked surplus tokens via recover_surplus without reducing balance below tracked liability.
